report.Subject: The steering committee of the Sexual Violence Prevention Initiative (SVPI) was tasked in fall 2023 by President Tim Sands to develop a plan for establishing sexual violence prevention as a shared responsibility of the Virginia Tech community. This strategic plan is the culmination of a year of conversation and analysis to inform sexual violence prevention work moving forward.
